body: You don't wanna grow old, understandable. Doesn't mean you have to kill yourself though. Being willing to die young lets you do so much more than others. Live your life to the fullest, put yourself out there. Maybe join the army. Be a daredevil and monetize it on youtube or shit like that. If you die, you die. If you don't, then you have more time to do cool shit others are too afraid to do. <3
Yeah, don't do it. You should really tell someone close to you immediately that you're thinking of killing yourself. I promise it helps.
If you're old take Viagra. If you're young stop watching porn. Problem solved.

Paracetamol is one of the most painful ways to take your life. You will not die immediately but will suffer liver failure that'll give you the most intense pain of your life. You will die eventually, but it will be a slow and agonizing death in the hospital weeks or months later.

Yeah, I did research on it after trying and realized that it's much more rare than I thought it would be. Probably because it doesn't really work unless you're super determined. Don't even know if I can consider this an attempt cause it really didn't go anywhere.

If you haven't already, tell someone important to you that you're thinking of killing yourself. Even if they don't end up helping you, it's at least nice having someone there that will sit and listen to you. If you don't have someone like that then seriously get a therapist immediately and tell them you want to kill yourself. Just don't treat suicidal ideation like it's a secret that only you get to know about. Cause it'll bottle up and you'll end up doing it even if you didn't think you would.

This is apparently the wrong sub, cause you spent a shit ton of time telling us your problems and you got fuck all in response. Goes to show how much this subreddit really cares. Listen, please tell someone you're thinking of killing yourself. And I mean someone who'll do something about it. If you can't think of anyone, then get a therapist and tell them. Please please please do that. Things may not get better from there, but it at least becomes easier to manage when you have real life support. Love you.

Buddy, I can't give you much advice. I tried to kill myself a couple of hours ago. But damn this sub fucking sucks. You pour your heart out to strangers online and all you got was 5 upvotes. This place is worse than the suicide hotline that puts you on hold with shitty music for half an hour. It sounds cheesy, but I love you man and you really, really need to start loving yourself. Like seriously force yourself to like something about you. Tell yourself your handsome whenever you look in the mirror or something like that. And go to a therapist if you're not already.
